cards: Not used on this site: every list holds its own Card blocks. Leave empty; card entries chosen here would replace the cards.
blog: When the list has no cards, it shows the latest posts of this blog as cards. Used for the case study rows on three service pages.
ts_show_for: Leave as it is. The other values show the list only when its cards are short figures, or only plain facts. Seven service page heroes use them.
card_style: Bordered: ruled cells. Plain: only the lines between cells. Tinted: ruled cells on light gray. Keep what the page already uses, usually Bordered.
ts_icon_style: For cards with icons, choose Bare icon, 24px: the site's icon style. Tile puts the icon in a small tile; the accent option puts it beside the label.
columns: 4 for short cards, 3 for cards with photos and longer text. A list never shows more columns than it has cards.
columns_mobile: 1 for cards with text. 2 only for short tiles, figures or photos.
ts_desktop_from: Below this width the tablet columns apply. Pick 1200px when 4 columns get too narrow on small laptops.
ts_tablet_columns: For screens 750 to 989 pixels wide. Auto: at most 2. Leave on Auto unless the page already uses another value.
ts_copy_first: Below 990 pixels, a row of text and photo shows the text first, then the photo.
ts_pairs: Cards in reading order: text 1, image 1, text 2, image 2… Phones then show each text before its image. Needs twice as many cards as columns.
ts_flush: Leave off. Used once, for a list inside a text column: the cards line up with the text, with no outer frame.
ts_foot_strip: Leave off. Used once, for a list of names that closes a text column, as a ruled strip along the section's bottom line.
ts_link_button: Each card's link shows as an outline button with its link label; the card itself is not a link. Cards without a link show no button.
ts_even_rows: When photos don't fill the last row, the leftover photos share it, a bit taller, with no white gap. A single last photo becomes a wide band.
ts_label_style: Number: the card's label shows as a large blue number, like 01. In Numbered steps it replaces the automatic number.
ts_chips_beside: A label written “a · b · c” shows as check lines beside the title and text (from 750 pixels), instead of check chips under the text.
ts_line_checks: In a card text with one item per line, each line starts with a check instead of a small square.
ts_tiles_center: Tiles layout: centres the icon and the name in each tile. Turn it on when the tiles have icons. Off: the name sits at the tile's foot.
ts_link_media: Shows each card's photo above its title and arrow, with Show images on; the whole card stays the link. On phones the photo sits beside the title.
image_ratio: The shape of every card photo. Keep one ratio per list.
title_tag: The heading level of the card titles, for search engines and screen readers. Keep H3 under a section heading.
ts_title_size: Section: card titles as big as a section heading. Only for large rows of text beside a photo.
link_label: The link text for cards that have a link but no link label of their own. Usually “Learn more”.
